methodology.universe: Historical S&P 500 point-in-time membership via pitindex on each as-of date
methodology.selection: Same deterministic random 50-calendar-day windows for every preset; starts are business days and at least 65 days apart
methodology.portfolio: Equal-weight Top 30 and Top 100 ranked stocks; return measured from last close on/before as-of to last close on/before end
methodology.benchmark: S&P 500 price index (^GSPC) over the identical window
methodology.survivorship_bias: Historical point-in-time membership used; unavailable historical tickers are reported as failed rather than replaced with current constituents

preset_definitions.defensive: 40% trend, 30% low volatility, 15% support, 10% RSI near 40, 5% RVOL
preset_definitions.low_macd: 50% low negative MACD, 20% trend, 15% RSI near 33, 10% RVOL, 5% support
preset_definitions.low_rsi: 55% genuinely low RSI (full <=25, zero at 50), 20% trend, 10% RVOL, 10% support, 5% RSI reversal
preset_definitions.confirmed_pullback: 25% trend, 20% RSI near 35, 15% RSI rebound, 15% RVOL, 15% MACD near -10, 10% moderate volatility
